name: Christmas Canadian Pet Expo
description: A two-day holiday pet show across three indoor halls, with a dog show, cat show, grooming arena, main stage, Santa Paws photos and a holiday marketplace. Leashed, vaccinated pets are welcome. Open Saturday 10 AM–5 PM and Sunday 10 AM–4 PM; last admission one hour before closing. Free parking.
